title: Astragalin Inhibits Oxidative Stress-Induced Pyroptosis and Apoptosis in Mouse Models of Renal Ischemia/Reperfusion Injury by Activating the SIRT1/Nrf2 Pathway.
authors: Huang, Qian; Shi, Zilu; Zheng, Dandan; Chen, Huiqin; Huang, Qiuhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮类化合物紫云英苷通过SIRT1/Nrf2通路抑制肾缺血再灌注损伤中的氧化应激、焦亡和凋亡，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Natural flavonoid astragalin (AST) has many pharmacological effects and has been reported to improve renal injury in diabetic kidney disease. This study aimed to investigate the role of AST in renal ischemia/reperfusion injury (RIRI) and elucidate related mechanisms. The RIRI mouse models were pre-treated with AST (25, 50, or 75 mg/kg) 24 h before ischemia/reperfusion surgery. The effects of AST on pathological renal injury in mice after I/R were determined using hematoxylin-eosin staining. HK-2 cells were pre-treated with AST (50, 100, or 200 muM) for 24 h before exposure to hypoxia/reoxygenation. The impact of AST on oxidative stress, apoptosis, and pyroptosis, as well as the Sirt1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway in vivo and in vitro, was detected. The binding of AST with Sirt1 was verified using molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). AST ameliorated pathological renal injury, reduced ROS production and MDA levels, increased SOD activity, and inhibited apoptosis and NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis in mice after I/R. AST attenuated H/R-induced oxidative stress, apoptosis, and pyroptosis in HK-2 cells. Mechanically, AST increased the levels of Sirt1, Nrf2, and HO-1 in the kidneys of mice undergoing I/R and in H/R-stimulated HK-2 cells. The inhibition of Sirt1 by EX725 or si-Sirt1 reversed the protective effects of AST on RIRI. AST exhibits renoprotective effects in RIRI by alleviating oxidative stress-induced pyroptosis and apoptosis by activating the SIRT1/Nrf2 pathway, suggesting that AST might be a novel therapeutic agent for RIRI.
abstract_zh: 天然黄酮类化合物黄芪苷（AST）具有多种药理作用，并已被报道可改善糖尿病肾病中的肾损伤。本研究旨在探讨AST在肾缺血/再灌注损伤（RIRI）中的作用，并阐明相关机制。在缺血/再灌注手术前24小时，用AST（25、50或75 mg/kg）预处理RIRI小鼠模型。通过苏木精-伊红染色测定AST对I/R后小鼠病理性肾损伤的影响。在缺氧/复氧暴露前24小时，用AST（50、100或200 μM）预处理HK-2细胞。检测AST对氧化应激、凋亡和焦亡以及体内外Sirt1/Nrf2/HO-1通路的影响。使用分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）验证AST与Sirt1的结合。AST改善了I/R后小鼠的病理性肾损伤，降低了ROS产生和MDA水平，增加了SOD活性，并抑制了凋亡和NLRP3介导的焦亡。AST减弱了HK-2细胞中H/R诱导的氧化应激、凋亡和焦亡。机制上，AST增加了经历I/R的小鼠肾脏和H/R刺激的HK-2细胞中Sirt1、Nrf2和HO-1的水平。通过EX725或si-Sirt1抑制Sirt1逆转了AST对RIRI的保护作用。AST通过激活SIRT1/Nrf2通路减轻氧化应激诱导的焦亡和凋亡，从而在RIRI中发挥肾脏保护作用，表明AST可能是RIRI的新型治疗药物。
